messages.author: c9eec36a3a9e119a
messages.subject: binned analysis
parts:
According to R help: Distance Detection Function Fitting: "Currently, a binned analysis can only be done for method="ds" and eventually int.range will be incorporated into the dataframe."

I've been playing around trying to estimate a MCDS model with binned data to no luck. Is this still not possible except by adding columns distbegin and distend to the dataframe?

Thanks!

messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] binned analysis
parts:
Hi Kay, hi listfolk,

You can perform a binned analysis in mrds only by using the distbegin
and distend columns. For the Distance package you can use the
cutpoints=... argument, which might be easier to specify.

Hope this helps!

cheers,
--dave
